about: Each seat's own next regular election year for a legislative body whose seats are elected on a published staggered schedule, keyed by the research roster's district name (one year per member of that district, in order). Read by src/core2/offices-state.ts; a body not listed here takes turns by district number (SG-GOV-term-end-estimate). Years are the first of each seat's four-year cycle not before the opening.

unicameral.spread: plus or minus one cycle (two years) for a seat whose last election the Board of Elections page was not read for
unicameral.citation: D.C. Code sec. 1-204.01(a) sets the 13 seats; the cycle is the Council's published staggering: the Chairman and wards 1, 3, 5 and 6 with two at-large seats in the 2022 and 2026 elections, wards 2, 4, 7 and 8 with the other two at-large seats in 2024 and 2028 (read from the 2020-2024 election results; the Board of Elections schedule page itself was not fetched, so the years are estimates)
